base_url.correction: No operational Realty Mole base URL; replacement: https://api.rentcast.io/v1

free_tier.correction: No current Realty Mole free tier because the API is shut down; replacement RentCast has a free Developer plan.

free_tier_limits.correction: The former Realty Mole Basic plan and replacement RentCast Developer plan provide 50 requests per month.

rate_limits.correction: Not applicable to the shut-down API; replacement RentCast has a hard limit of 20 requests per second per API key.

description.correction: Legacy US property-data API formerly hosted on RapidAPI; permanently shut down on March 1, 2025 and replaced by RentCast.

notes: Official provider documentation says Realty Mole and its RapidAPI endpoints were discontinued and permanently shut down on March 1, 2025. The entry's operational status and present-tense description are therefore false. RapidAPI keys and URLs must be replaced with RentCast credentials and endpoints.
